summary: Customer wants in-line fiber optic measurement on a conveyor belt at a remediation site to sort excavated soil by moisture and organic content before drying. Soil is lumpy, dark, and variable. They ask whether a fiber optic measurement above or on the belt can give a continuous reading and which method to test first.
